comment: Kit for POST /admin/v1/players/:userId/tester-max (src/controllers/testerMaxCore.ts). Copy to tester_max_kit.json and adjust it. Our own server's kit: player level and weapons to level 20 (player-level XP follows weapon XP in the game, so weapons at 20 need player level 20; every rank reached is confirmed) and four currencies (Rams CURRENCY_NOTES, Combat Merits CURRENCY_PJM_WEAPON, Aether Dust CURRENCY_CELLDUST, Reward Cache coins CURRENCY_SEASONAL_COIN, which is prestige-gated and credited without banked prestige by this tool). There is no Slayer's Path section: a tester unlocks it in game. progression: targetProgress is the XP the track is set to (never lowered); "max" is the top regular rank (TrackCapXp); the track must be an approved XP track in progression_config.json. inventory (optional, not used here): stacked adds by catalog id; every id must be in inventory_storage_policy.json and in Items_Analysis/catalog_1_14_7.jsonl, and inventing one puts a dead row in the account. currencies: CURRENCY_* ids; the CURRENCY_PLATINUM aggregate is refused (grant a CURRENCY_PLATINUM_* bucket for Platinum). Every grant carries the economy source OPERATOR_TEST, which the activity and economy monitors do not count.
